g.text: Lifecycle arrival batches: client cap 16 versus 64
Points: median of 3 run statistics; bands: observed run min–max. Server startup admission remains unchanged.
Rates use complete finite-batch windows, including drain. Not-dispatched denominator: scheduled arrivals. Latency is create only.
